hook.note: Opens with frxiaobei's concrete post and immediately turns it into a structural claim.

thesis.note: Main thesis appears in opening and is reinforced across sections: default workflow, not model/demo.

blind_spot_section.note: Boundary section covers compliance, provider subscriptions, production adoption, and path dependency.

practitioner_section.note: CTO, product owner, solution team, and internal financial institution team each receive concrete takeaways.

keywords.note: Five keywords are full explanatory paragraphs, not glossary fragments.

references.note: Original repository URL is first; social and official sources follow.

translationese.note: Some English product terms intentionally remain in English because they are source artifact names.

overclaiming.note: Article avoids claiming production deployment, transaction execution, or investment recommendations.
